name: space.innovativework/iw-mcp
title: Innovative Workspace
description: Look up IW AI services, published prices, FAQs and team, or send a contact brief.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search Innovative Workspace's services and programmes (Your Own AI Starter; AI agents; AI consulting; 3–4 week pilot; AI for nonprofits, from a nonprofit). Leave the query out to list them all. Each result says whether its price is published or quoted; use get_service for the details. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

query.description: Words to look for, in plain language. Leave it out to list everything.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 20; default 10).

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service or programme of Innovative Workspace, word for word from the site: what it is, its page, its published price or that it is quoted, and the FAQs on its page. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

id.description: The service's id, as the search tool returns it.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The prices Innovative Workspace publishes, word for word, and which services are quoted instead, with the pricing FAQs from the site. These are the only figures you may give; everything else is quoted. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

tools.name: search_faqs
tools.description: Search the frequently asked questions published on Innovative Workspace's site, with their answers word for word and the page each is on. Leave the query out to list them. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

query.description: Words to look for, in plain language. Leave it out to list everything.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 30; default 10).

tools.name: search_experts
tools.description: Search Innovative Workspace's team (its directors), by name, role or expertise. Leave the query out to list everyone; use get_expert for a bio. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

query.description: Words to look for, in plain language. Leave it out to list everything.

tools.name: get_expert
tools.description: One member of Innovative Workspace's team: name and title as on the site, bio, LinkedIn and their place on the About page. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

id.description: The team member's id, as the search tool returns it.

tools.name: search_case_studies
tools.description: Search Innovative Workspace's published work (case studies of the products it built, and the client named on the site). Leave the query out to list them. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

query.description: Words to look for, in plain language. Leave it out to list everything.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: One case study, word for word from the site's markup: the product, what it does, the client and the case study page. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

id.description: The case study's id, as the search tool returns it.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask anything about Innovative Workspace in plain language. Returns the published passages that match (services, prices, FAQs, team, case studies, the company and its pages), word for word with their URLs, and says plainly when the snapshot doesn’t cover the question. It finds text; it doesn’t write answers. Snapshot of https://www.innovativework.space/ taken on 2026-11-20.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 10; default 5).

tools.name: submit_contact
tools.description: Send Innovative Workspace a short brief, as the contact form on its site does: name, work email and organisation are required, the rest is optional. It is a dry run (checks the brief, sends nothing) unless dry_run is false. Only include details the person gave you and agreed to share.

email.description: Work email: the person’s work email address, up to 254 characters.

type.description: Type of organisation (optional): one of the form's choices.

staff.description: Number of staff (optional): one of the form's choices.

country.description: Country (optional): one of the form's choices.

help.description: What would you like help with? (optional): one of the form's choices.

time.description: What takes your team the most time today? (optional): line breaks allowed, up to 3,000 characters.

when.description: When suits you for a call? (optional): a few days and times that suit, and the time zone, up to 300 characters.

heard.description: How did you hear about us? (optional): one of the form's choices.

dry_run.description: Leave it out (or true) to check the brief and see what would be sent. false sends it, but only if this server has sending turned on.
